pageSubtitle: Learn more about my journey, skills, and what drives me
story: Hello! I'm a passionate full-stack developer with a love for creating beautiful, functional, and user-centered digital experiences. My journey in web development started several years ago, and since then, I've been constantly learning and growing in this ever-evolving field.

I specialize in building modern web applications using technologies like Vue.js, Nuxt, React, Node.js, and various databases. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and creating intuitive user interfaces that provide exceptional experiences.
When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or enjoying a good cup of coffee while reading about the latest trends in tech.

experience.description: Leading development of web applications using Vue.js and Node.js.
Built and maintained multiple client projects with React and Python.
Started my career building frontend interfaces and learning best practices.
